verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework whose source is published on GitHub, and its CLI documents running it entirely on your own machine or infrastructure: creating workspaces, building and serving apps locally, and invoking deploy builders. No hosted vendor service is needed to use the core product. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, first-party docs framing self-hosted or air-gapped use, independent corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
